project.name: WrackLuck
project.description: Bottle mail where words drift and arrive by chance.
project.description_ja: 言葉が漂い、偶然に届くボトルメール。

immutable_principles: No scores or numerical values in UI. Always expressed as sensation.
Minimum drift time: 3-6 hours. The inconvenience is intentional.
AI letters are flotsam, not human imitation. Suspicion does not damage the experience.
The sea ultimately delivers. Dead storage is prevented by the system.
Seawater refracts meaning. Words that arrive are not guaranteed to be the words that were sent.

mvp_spec.translation: hidden in MVP, post-MVP opt-in with intentional imperfection

not_adopted: Gyres (folder-like collection feature) — conflicts with 'cannot be owned' philosophy
Star chart UI for drift direction control — conflicts with inoperability principle
Real-time drift simulation — deferred to post-MVP
post_mvp_features: Additional creatures: deep sea fish, whale, migratory bird, octopus, sea turtle, pelican, dolphin
Multilingual send support with language-specific degradation
Journey title system (auto-generated from history logs)

files_produced_this_session.description: Project identity, philosophy summary, MVP features, future vision, AI relay provenance
Immutable design principles, 9 chapters, EN/JA bilingual
Core algorithms in pseudocode, 10 sections + tunable parameters appendix
Canonical relay state for future AI handoff

open_questions: Navigation score unlock threshold (to be determined from real usage data)
Exact scent tag categories for MVP (3-5, to be defined during implementation)
Noise range tuning for receiver selection (philosophical parameter, default 0.0-0.15)
